description: Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed is the faster variant of K3.1 Pro, a multimodal reasoning model for coding, 3D creation, document analysis and multi-step tool use. It supports a 1M-token context window and text, image and video inputs. Reasoning is always enabled, with low, high and max effort levels.
name: Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed
